items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: this guy was a Captain, not a lieutenant, a Captain in the Army and she whipped him.

ctx.x: Bouchand. Put her razor here, and she was bigger than I am. I only weigh 145 soaking wet and she must have weighed about 180. And she said, "Bouchand, you going with me tonight." I said, "I got to go to Chicago." "You ain't going to go nowhere." And she put me in her Cadillac and then took me to the house. Well, I had my hand bag packed and my horns and so we're sitting up drinking and about 6:00 o'clock in the morning everybody's hungry. Of course, I'd been to her house several times during the week, but this…
